texts: Collectors grind the dried feathers in a mortar.
Copper boxes in the Watch hold the ground feathers.
One handful of ground feathers protects one lantern for about a month.
The Council issues feather rations at each full-moon meeting.

q1_issues.issue: (PartOf sk_feather_1 sky_cat) puts a KIND in the whole slot of a part-whole link whose other argument is an individual group witness; the specified pattern ('the car engine') mints a witness for the whole, and the individual/class discipline bars mixing the two.

q2_gaps: a possessor/whole + part compound whose WHOLE is generic rather than a specific referent ('sky-cat feathers' = feathers of sky-cats at large) — the non-fusing PartOf route is specified only with a witness whole, and no form is given for a kind-level whole that does not assert one particular individual
review.notes: Correct calls elsewhere: the definite plural takes a group witness (never Inheritance), 'sky-cat feathers' is not fused into a compound, 'collector' in referring subject position gets no (can collect) capability atom, and 'dry' takes Patient as a treatment that changes the object.

issues.reason: PartOf's two documented jobs - a component of an object and a member of a group - take individuals on both sides, and the specified "car engine" pattern mints a witness whole with its own Member atom, so the bare kind sky_cat in the whole slot is ill-typed and, read literally, false: this particular group of feathers is not a component of a species.

gaps_confirmed: a possessor/whole + part compound whose WHOLE is generic rather than a specific referent ("sky-cat feathers" = feathers of sky-cats at large) - the non-fusing PartOf route is specified only with a witness whole
new_gaps: a kind-level whole in a part-whole link has NO licensed form at all: the witness route posits one particular sky-cat that every one of these feathers came from, and dropping the premodifier widens "the feathers" to feathers at large; a licensed form would need to say that each feather is a part of SOME member of the kind without minting a shared individual
adjudication.defect_summary: Both licensed alternatives misfire - the "car engine" pattern would give (Member sk_sky_cat_1 sky_cat) (PartOf sk_feather_1 sk_sky_cat_1), asserting one specific sky-cat as the source of all the feathers, and dropping the premodifier widens the definite plural - so the instruction set licenses no faithful form for a kind-level whole, filed above as a gap.
adjudication.notes: The rest is right: the bare-plural habitual subject becomes a distributing rule at 0.9/0.9, the definite plural object takes a group witness, the top-level constant sk_feather_1 inside the rule conclusion is licensed (a fact asserts it), and "dry" takes Patient as a treatment that changes the object.

fields.sentence: Collectors grind the dried feathers in a mortar.

review.notes: Bare-plural habitual subject correctly takes the distributing rule at 0.9/0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase; the definite plural object takes a group witness with "dried" (participial modifier kept as an adjective, not lemmatized to the verb) distributed over members at 1.0/0.9. The indefinite "a mortar" under the universal is correctly a dependent Skolem function, and Location is the licensed head for the surface "in".

fields.sentence: Copper boxes in the Watch hold the ground feathers.

q1_issues.issue: (Inheritance ground_feather ground) exposes a modifier genus the compound rule does not license - on the noun reading ('ground' = the earth) a noun modifier is never exposed, and on the participial-adjective reading it is neither gradable, positional/cardinal nor material, so only the head genus (Inheritance ground_feather feather) is licensed.

review.notes: Everything else holds: stative transitive 'hold' keeps Agent, 'the Watch' is a capitalized common-noun label with no Name atom, copper_box exposes no modifier genus (noun modifier), and the 'in the Watch' restriction becomes a premise conjunct on the distributing rule with the definite object group asserted at top level.

issues.reason: Neither reading licenses the atom: on the noun reading Compound concepts says 'A noun modifier is never exposed', and (Inheritance ground_feather ground) is then flatly false (a ground-feather is not a kind of earth); on the participial reading 'ground' is none of the three exposable adjective classes (gradable / positional-cardinal / material), and a participial state modifier is the 'incidental description' case the same section bars from fusing at all.

new_gaps: A processing-state participial modifier that names a recognized commodity kind ('ground feathers', 'ground pepper', 'smoked fish') sits between the term-of-art fusion licence and the 'never for incidental description (colour, size, damage, mood)' bar, and the modifier-exposure list (gradable / positional / material) and its predication test disagree for it — 'the feathers are ground' passes the test while no listed category fits.

'ground feathers' is a live noun-vs-participle lexical ambiguity, but Multiple live readings requires two COMPLETE readings and the two differ in a single decomposition atom, so it is unclear whether such a hairline sense split should trigger an Interpretation split or be resolved silently.
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form is the head genus alone — (Inheritance ground_feather feather) with 'ground' left inside the fused symbol — or, if 'ground' is read as a descriptive participial modifier, no fusion at all and the modifier distributed over the group's members per the plural distributive rule.
adjudication.notes: Everything else conforms: stative-transitive 'hold' keeps Agent, 'the Watch' is a capitalized common-noun label with no Name atom, copper_box correctly exposes no noun-modifier genus, and the 'in the Watch' restriction rightly becomes a premise conjunct on the distributing rule.

fields.sentence: One handful of ground feathers protects one lantern for about a month.

q1_issues.issue: The plural "ground feathers" is typed as a single individual — (Member sk_ground_feather_1 ground_feather) rather than a group witness (GroupOf ... ground_feather) — so the parse asserts one feather instead of the many a handful contains, and both the handful Measure and the protect event's Agent hang off that singular symbol.

q2_gaps: measure-partitive quantity NP ("one handful of ground feathers"; the instruction set's own example "a cup of water") — explicitly excluded from the possessive/genitive of-phrase routes but given no positive encoding, and "a handful" is addressed only as a vague-count CardinalityPhrase, never as a measure unit
review.notes: The duration is right — Measure ... duration with (ParticleFromNormal 1 0.1) for the tight hedge "about" — as are Agent on the inanimate transitive subject, Theme for the unchanged lantern, and the reserved unspecified scale symbol. Whether "ground feathers" should fuse at all is debatable: the nearest exemplar, participial "a laminated worktop", stays two atoms.

issues.reason: Coordination & plurals requires a plural referred to as a unit to take (GroupOf <group> <kind>), and warns that a bare Member on the collection says the group-as-object IS one of that kind, so (Member sk_ground_feather_1 ground_feather) asserts a single feather where the text describes a handful of many -- and the plural/count noun is exactly the cue the Partitives section gives for the GroupOf route rather than the mass Member+PartOf one.

gaps_confirmed: measure-partitive quantity NP ('one handful of ground feathers', the instruction set's own excluded example 'a cup of water'): explicitly barred from the genitive of-phrase routes but given no positive encoding, and 'a handful' appears only as a vague-count CardinalityPhrase, never as a counted measure unit
new_gaps: a participial preparation modifier ('ground feathers', 'dried herbs', 'powdered bark') sits between the fuse test's two poles -- it is neither a listed fusing classifier (term of art, nationality, role title, material adjective) nor plainly incidental description like the two-atom 'laminated worktop' -- so whether it fuses, and whether the participle is then exposable as a modifier genus, is undecided
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form gives the plural a group witness -- (GroupOf sk_group_1 ground_feather) -- and hangs the quantity atom and the protect event's Agent on that group symbol; the 'one handful of' quantity itself still has no licensed carrier, since CardinalityPhrase records a vague word rather than a stated count of measure units, so that half remains a gap.
adjudication.notes: The duration is right (Measure ... duration with (ParticleFromNormal 1 0.1) for the tight hedge 'about'), as are Agent on the inanimate transitive subject, Theme for the unaltered lantern, the reserved unspecified scale symbol, and the absence of a tense atom on the generic present.

fields.sentence: The Council issues feather rations at each full-moon meeting.

q1_issues.issue: The explicit quantifier word "each" ranges over exactly the domain the rule quantifies (`full_moon_meeting`), so the mandatory companion `(QuantifierPhrase full_moon_meeting issue "each")` is missing — the companion is required for every explicit quantifier word the rule consumes, and only the "every time / whenever" wording is exempted.

q2_gaps: a universally-quantified temporal PP over an event noun ("at each full-moon meeting"): the instruction set legislates "every time / whenever <clause>" (occurrence domain -> rule + `During`) and calendar-slot frequencies (`Time` term + `Every`/`TimesPer`), but not a determiner-quantified event-noun adjunct, so both the rule route and its `During` tie are extrapolated here — and the surface preposition is "at", which the oblique rule would otherwise send to `(At <event> <meeting>)`, `During` being reserved for during/while/throughout
review.notes: "The Council" correctly stays a common-noun witness with no `Name` atom, the compounds `feather_ration` and `full_moon_meeting` expose only their head genus (noun modifiers), and rule strength/confidence 1.0/0.9 matches the "each" universal. The bare-plural object `feather_ration` as a kind filler is defensible in a non-episodic habitual clause.

issues.reason: "The companion is mandatory for every explicit quantifier word the rule or claim consumes" and "it only ever restates a range the rule itself quantifies" — "each" is explicit and the rule quantifies exactly the range it determines (full_moon_meeting), while the only stated exemption is the "every time / whenever" wording, which is not what this sentence uses.

gaps_confirmed: A determiner-quantified event-noun adjunct ("at each full-moon meeting") is legislated nowhere: the occurrence-domain machinery is specified for "every time / whenever <clause>" and the calendar-slot machinery for named slots (Time term + Every / TimesPer), so both the rule route and the During tie are extrapolations — and the surface preposition is "at", where During is restricted to during/while/throughout.
new_gaps: The QuantifierPhrase companion's shape is (QuantifierPhrase <kind> <verb-lemma> "<word>"), which presumes the quantified range is a participant kind; nothing states how the slots are filled when the quantified range is an event-noun ADJUNCT domain rather than a participant, so even the compliant companion here is a slot-filling extrapolation.
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form adds the companion beside the rule: (: fmm_q (QuantifierPhrase full_moon_meeting issue "each") (STV 1.0 0.99)).
adjudication.notes: Routing "each full-moon meeting" as an occurrence domain rather than a calendar slot is right — meetings are entities, not calendar terms — and the During tie is the machinery's own prescription, not a rendering of surface "at".
